name: NIST CFReDS
what: Reference data sets with documented contents, made for testing tools and practising examinations.

name: Digital Corpora
what: Disk images, memory dumps, network captures and scenario data sets for education and research.

name: MemLabs
what: A series of capture-the-flag style labs for learning memory forensics.

name: DFIR Artifact Museum
what: A community archive of sample artifacts from many operating systems.

name: EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES
what: Windows event log samples for known attack techniques, good for testing log hunting tools.

name: CyberDefenders
what: Blue-team challenges with downloadable evidence. Some labs are free.

name: NIST Computer Forensics Tool Testing (CFTT)
what: Test reports and methods for validating forensic tools. Read these before trusting any tool in a real case.
